# terrakube_project_access (Data Source)

Looks up the access a team has to a project by team name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "terrakube_organization" "org" {
  name = "my-organization"
}

data "terrakube_project" "project" {
  organization = data.terrakube_organization.org.name
  name         = "my-project"
}

data "terrakube_project_access" "platform" {
  organization_id = data.terrakube_organization.org.id
  project_id      = data.terrakube_project.project.id
  name            = "platform-team"
}

output "platform_team_role" {
  value = data.terrakube_project_access.platform.role
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Team name
- `organization_id` (String) Terrakube organization ID
- `project_id` (String) Terrakube project ID

### Read-Only

- `approve_job` (Boolean) Allowed to approve and apply runs. Only used when role is unset or custom.
- `destroy_job` (Boolean) Allowed to run destroy (Terrakube 2.34.0+). Null when the API does not return it.
- `id` (String) Access ID
- `manage_job` (Boolean) Allowed to manage and trigger jobs
- `manage_state` (Boolean) Allowed to manage Terraform/OpenTofu state
- `manage_workspace` (Boolean) Allowed to manage workspaces
- `plan_job` (Boolean) Allowed to queue plans. Only used when role is unset or custom.
- `role` (String) Predefined role: admin, write, plan, read or custom. Null when unset.
